title: Persistent player profile (local storage MVP) — stable playerId + lifetime stats, no unlocks yet
intent: Add a minimum-viable persistent player profile stored in `localStorage`. Holds: a stable `playerId` (generated once per browser, persists across page refreshes + browser restarts), lifetime stats (matches played, matches won, rounds played, rounds won, deaths-by-own-bomb, chain-reactions-triggered), preferred-recipe seed (the last recipe the player chose to play with). NO cosmetic unlocks, NO server sync, NO accounts. Pure local persistence. Closes two existing gaps immediately: (1) GDP-2026-05-22-012 reconnect-grace needs a stable playerId that survives page refresh — currently it relies on sessionStorage (same-tab only). (2) The HUD's per-session tally (W:A L:B D:C) resets on page reload — players lose their progress feel. The profile fixes both at zero design risk. Opens (doesn't commit) the door to cosmetic unlocks + cross-session match history as later layers.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/gdd.md Cosmetic unlocks (planned, MVP-3+)` — explicit dependency: 'Requires a persistent player profile to exist first. Local storage works for offline play; the connected / authoritative profile lets unlocks cross devices.' Plus `gameplay-systems.md §14 #7` — open question 'Cosmetic unlock conditions — defer to the cosmetic-unlocks design pass'. This story lands the FOUNDATION the unlock pass needs; it doesn't commit the unlocks themselves. Marked `should` because two existing systems already need stable playerId (GDP-022-012 reconnect grace, the multi-tab session experience) — foundation is overdue. Plus the user's gradual content-variety direction is approaching diminishing returns; opening session-depth as a parallel track keeps the roadmap fresh without forcing a hard pivot.
acceptanceHints: Pure additive — no existing system changes behaviour, only NEW data layer.
STORAGE: `localStorage` only. NO server sync, NO IndexedDB (overkill for this scope). Profile lives at key `kaboom.player.profile.v1`. Key versioning lets future format migrations land cleanly.
PROFILE SCHEMA (examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json or a new examples/kaboom-crew/src/profile/ module):
PlayerProfile {
agfFormatVersion: 1,
playerId: string,                // generated on first load via crypto.randomUUID(); persists forever
createdAt: number,               // Date.now() at first creation
lastSeenAt: number,              // updated on every page load
preferredRecipeSeed?: number,    // last recipe seed the player committed to (optional)
lifetimeStats: {
matchesPlayed: number,
matchesWon: number,
roundsPlayed: number,
roundsWon: number,
roundsLost: number,
roundsDraw: number,
deathsByOwnBomb: number,
chainReactionsTriggered: number,    // count of bombs that detonated a 2+ bomb chain
maxChainLength: number,             // largest single chain reaction this player has triggered
pickupsCollected: { [kind: string]: number }    // per-kind counter
examples/kaboom-crew/src/profile/profile-store.ts: NEW.
`loadProfile(): PlayerProfile` — reads from localStorage; creates default if absent.
`saveProfile(profile: PlayerProfile): void` — writes to localStorage.
`getOrCreateProfile(): PlayerProfile` — load + update lastSeenAt + save + return. Called once at bootstrap.
`incrementStat(key: string, by?: number): void` — convenience for per-event stat bumps.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/profile/profile-events.ts: NEW.
Subscribes to existing ECS events (RoundResolveSystem flips, BlastEvent chain count, BomberStats.alive flip with self-blast detection, PickupCollect kind).
Per event: increment the matching lifetimeStats counter via the profile-store. Debounce localStorage writes to once per 2s (batches stat bumps; avoids hammering localStorage on rapid events).
PLAYERID INTEGRATION:

GDP-2026-05-22-012 (multiplayer reconnect grace, shipped S125 era) currently uses sessionStorage for playerId — same-tab only. This story shifts to localStorage profile.playerId — refresh-the-tab survives reconnect grace works correctly across refreshes.
Client.join protocol message uses profile.playerId. No protocol changes (the field already exists).
RECIPE PREFERENCE:
When the player loads with a `?recipe=` URL param, save the resolved recipe's seed to profile.preferredRecipeSeed.
When the player loads WITHOUT a URL recipe, use profile.preferredRecipeSeed (if present) instead of the default. Player's bomber stays visually consistent across sessions.
This is the lowest-impact cross-session continuity feature, closest to the user's existing experience.
HUD CHANGES — MINIMAL:
Optional: a tiny lifetime indicator in the bottom-left HUD's tally row — `S:5/12` (5 matches won out of 12 played, lifetime). Single line, opt-in via URL `?showLifetime=true`.
Default: lifetime stats hidden in HUD (no UI clutter). Stats accumulate silently in the profile; UI surfaces them only when the user asks (or when later stories like cosmetic unlocks consume them).
RESET MECHANISM:
Agent probe: `window.__agf.kaboom.resetProfile()` — clears localStorage profile. Useful for QA/screenshot tests to start clean.
No user-facing reset button in v1 (avoids 'rage-reset' impulse killing months of stats).
AGENT PROBE SURFACE:
`window.__agf.kaboom.getProfile()` — returns the full profile object (for screenshot/regression tests).
`window.__agf.kaboom.setProfileStats(partial)` — overrides stat values for testing (e.g. set roundsWon=10 to test future unlock at-threshold UI).

DOCTOR INTEGRATION: engine doctor section for the kaboom-crew project — 'Player profile: playerId=<id>, age=<days>, matches=N, roundsWon=M'. Surfaces the persistence working without requiring browser inspection.

PRIVACY: localStorage is per-origin per-browser. No tracking, no analytics, no server transmission. The user can clear it via browser tools at will. Doc the explicit no-tracking stance in the kaboom-crew README + the profile module's header comment.
UNIT TESTS:
getOrCreateProfile creates default if localStorage empty; subsequent calls return same playerId.
saveProfile + loadProfile roundtrip preserves all fields.
Schema version mismatch on load (e.g. v2 in storage, v1 in code) → graceful fallback to defaults + warning logged. Reset doesn't delete; sits alongside until migration story lands.
Stat increments are atomic (load + increment + save handles concurrent calls; debounce prevents lost updates).
Event-subscriber wiring: simulated RoundResolveSystem event → matchesPlayed increments; simulated chain-reaction → chainReactionsTriggered increments + maxChainLength tracks the larger of the two.
FORWARD HOOKS (NOT shipped here — listed so the schema doesn't lock them out):
cosmeticUnlocks: string[] — list of unlocked accessory keys. Achievements layer fills this. SEPARATE STORY.
matchHistory: array of past matches with timestamps + outcomes. Larger; SEPARATE STORY.
achievements: array of named milestones (e.g. 'first-win', 'survived-chain'). SEPARATE STORY.
serverSync: when account-backed identity ships, sync playerId + profile to server. SEPARATE STORY.
OUT OF SCOPE (explicit):
Cosmetic unlocks (the headline feature this foundation eventually enables) — design pass deferred.
Match history list / dashboard UI.
Achievement system + popup banners on unlock.
Server-side profile / accounts / auth.
Cross-device profile sync.
Profile export / import (download .json + upload .json). Power-user feature; ship later if asked.
Lifetime stats dashboard (full-screen panel showing all stats). HUD-line + agent-probe is enough for v1.
